categories.purpose: Preserve business movements, corrections, allocation decisions, and accepted current-change history for subject reconstruction.
categories.retention: Retain for the business and statutory audit horizon; deletion requires an explicit owner-approved archival decision.
categories.deletion_condition: Only after the applicable business/legal retention horizon and a verified archive with subject-value read-back.

categories.purpose: Support incident diagnosis without becoming a second business read model.
categories.retention: Short, operator-defined window documented with the incident; extend only while an incident remains open.
categories.deletion_condition: After incident closure and confirmation that no audit or reproducibility evidence depends on the record.

categories.purpose: Provide an offline pre/post migration and restore control copy during the cutover decision window.
categories.retention: Until post-cutover verification, restore rehearsal, and owner sign-off are complete.
categories.deletion_condition: Explicit owner-approved deletion only after verified current subject values and restore evidence.
